svg.title: Ari connected topology schematic
svg.desc: Symbolic torso parameter grid with two armhole loops. Separate display rectangles show sleeve strips; their first vertex indices are shared with the torso. Not a 3D garment or sewing pattern.

g.text: Ari: one shared torso / sleeve structure
SCHEMATIC ONLY · no 3D positions, physical pattern or fit
